text: Talk for a minute or two in a quiet room.
instruction: Talk the way you would to Arya; don't read. Think aloud, trail off, start again. Stop when you run out.

text: Talk for a minute or two with the TV or music on.
instruction: Normal listening volume. Talk the same way as before.

text: [Say nothing. Leave the TV or music playing.]
instruction: Stay silent and let the recorder stop by itself after 60 seconds.
